personality_one_liner: Calm, trustworthy, and content-led personal finance dashboard with precise typographic hierarchy and glassmorphic clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, structured grouping, and iOS-native comfort spacing.

do's: Use frosted glass over sticky headers and bottom navigation
Apply translucent surface overlays on featured cards
dont's: Never blur body text or form inputs
Avoid excessive stacking of blurred layers

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of total balance, monthly budget progress, interactive spending charts, and quick actions.

states.loading: Centered spinner with branded botanical tone
states.empty: Botanical illustration with message 'No spending recorded this month' and primary CTA 'Add Transaction'
states.error: Readable error message with Retry button

screens.layout: Sticky header with profile avatar, total balance hero card with monthly delta pill, interactive segmented time-range chart (Weekly/Monthly/Yearly), Quick Action row (Send, Add, Budget, Scan), and Recent Transactions feed.

screens.name: Analytics & Charts
screens.purpose: Deep dive into category breakdown, cash flow trends, and comparative monthly summaries.

states.loading: Skeleton loading rows for category breakdown
states.empty: Illustration showing 'Insufficient data for trends' with action to import statements

screens.layout: Segmented control for Expense vs Income, interactive donut breakdown of top categories with percentage indicators, and monthly historical comparison bar chart.

screens.name: Categories
screens.purpose: Manage expense categories, budget limits, and category-specific spending caps.

states.empty: Empty state prompting creation of custom budget categories

screens.layout: Vertical list of expense categories with custom color indicators, spent vs allocated progress bars, and quick tap to edit limits.

screens.name: Monthly Summary
screens.purpose: Comprehensive review of monthly cash flow, savings rate, and financial health score.

states.empty: Prompt to generate first monthly report

screens.layout: Month picker header, financial health score card, income vs expense comparison meters, and downloadable PDF report preview.

screens.name: Transactions
screens.purpose: Searchable, filterable ledger of all financial activities and receipts.

states.empty: No transactions found matching filter criteria

screens.layout: Sticky search and filter bar, date-grouped transaction list with merchant logos/avatars, amounts, and category tags.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pristine personal finance spending dashboard (SpendPulse) following iOS-Native Clean guidelines.
Strictly adhere to the Botanical palette (Deep forest green #4A6B5D anchor, warm sand #F9F8F6 background, crisp dark charcoal text) and ban all blues, indigos, purples, and violets.
Implement tabular numerals for all currency amounts and numerical data to prevent layout jitter.
Ensure every branded entity (Apple, Spotify, Starbucks) uses fetched logo PNGs or clean initials fallback.
Include sticky bottom navigation, interactive spending charts, category breakdown, monthly summary, and quick action flows.
